title: Compactness Theorem 8.5.8 for rectifiable varifolds
statement: If V_j (j ∈ ℕ) are rectifiable n-varifolds (IsRectifiable) on open U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation, sup_j(μ_{V_j}(W) + ‖δV_j‖(W)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and Θ^n(μ_{V_j},x) exists and is ≥ 1 for x ∈ U ∖ A_j where μ_{V_j}(A_j ∩ W) → 0 for every W ⊂⊂ U, then some subsequence V_{φ(j)} converges as Radon measures on Gₙ(U) to a rectifiable V with locally bounded first variation, Θ^n(μ_V,·) ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e., and ‖δV‖(W) ≤ liminf_j ‖δV_{φ(j)}‖(W) for every open W ⊂⊂ U. (Exactly CompactnessTheorem.)
